tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: App canvas behind panels and cards. Warm off-white (not pure white) to cut glare during long sessions; warm charcoal (not pure black) in dark.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, modals, table body, inputs. The main working surface.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Table header rows, read-only fields, code blocks, the track behind progress bars.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for table rows, list items and quiet buttons.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: Left navigation rail in all three products. The one deep 'black' block of the brand.

tokens.name: sidebar-active
tokens.usage: Selected nav item background inside the sidebar.

tokens.name: on-sidebar
tokens.usage: Nav labels and icons on sidebar (12.6:1 light, 14.4:1 dark).

tokens.name: on-sidebar-muted
tokens.usage: Section headings and counts on sidebar (5.8:1 / 5.7:1).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers, card borders, table row separators. Decorative only, never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, checkboxes, selects (3.4:1 / 3.3:1 on surface, meets the 3:1 control rule).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg, surface and surface-sunken (≥13.8:1). Warm near-black, never #000.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, helper text, table meta, placeholders (≥5.9:1 on bg, surface, sunken).

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Moss green. Primary buttons, active tab underline, links, selected checkbox, progress fill. Text-safe on surface (7.2:1 / 7.8:1).

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed state of primary fills.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a primary fill (7.2:1 / 8.2:1).

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Selected row, active filter chip, current nav in light content areas. primary text on it is 6.1:1.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Clay / terracotta — the 'spark'. Brand moments only: logo chip, onboarding highlights, 'New' badges, one key KPI. Not for buttons.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Background for accent badges and highlight banners; accent text on it is 4.7:1 / 5.2:1.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Won deals, completed tasks, approved leave, 'Active' employees. Always paired with a label or icon.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Background for success badges and alerts.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Ochre. Due soon, pending approval, probation, at-risk projects.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Background for warning badges and alerts.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Brick. Overdue, lost deal, rejected, destructive buttons, field errors.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background for danger badges, error alerts and invalid-field fill.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Dusty slate blue. Neutral system notices, 'In review', informational links in alerts.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Background for info badges and alerts.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus outline: 2px solid with 2px offset. Clay so it never blends with moss primary (5.3:1 on bg).

tokens.name: data-1
tokens.usage: Chart series 1 (moss).

tokens.name: data-2
tokens.usage: Chart series 2 (clay).

tokens.name: data-3
tokens.usage: Chart series 3 (slate).

tokens.name: data-4
tokens.usage: Chart series 4 (ochre). 3.1:1 in light — use for fills/bars, not thin lines.

tokens.name: data-5
tokens.usage: Chart series 5 (heather).

tokens.name: data-6
tokens.usage: Chart series 6 (sage). Use fills, not 1px lines, in light theme.

tokens.name: product-sales
tokens.usage: Product marker for Sales & CRM — only on the product logo chip in the sidebar header.

tokens.name: product-projects
tokens.usage: Product marker for Project Management — logo chip only.

tokens.name: product-people
tokens.usage: Product marker for HR & People — logo chip only.

families.sans: Inter, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per page at most: dashboard welcome or big KPI number.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Page title in the top bar of every screen.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Sub-sections inside cards, modal titles, form group titles.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Follow up with the client on the revised quotation before Friday.
styles.usage: Default UI and paragraph text. Never go below 14px for reading text.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels, button text (sm), tab labels, table headers.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Badges and sidebar section headings only. Smallest size allowed.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: IDs, invoice numbers, codes. For money and counts in tables use body with tabular numbers instead.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, badge padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls, button icon gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell vertical padding, field gap inside a group.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding (compact), gap between form fields.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Modal padding, gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding (default), page side padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Empty-state padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Top/bottom breathing room on large pages.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, checkboxes, tags, tooltips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, nav items.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, modals, dropdown menus, popovers.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Avatars, toggles, progress bars, pill filters.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Cards resting on bg. Pair with a line border.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Dropdowns, popovers, toasts.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Modals and side drawers only.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Height of small buttons/inputs in dense toolbars and table rows.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default height of buttons, inputs, selects.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Login screen and primary mobile actions.

tokens.name: row-height
tokens.usage: Default table row height (comfortable). Compact mode 36px.

tokens.name: topbar-height
tokens.usage: App top bar holding page title, search and user menu.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Expanded sidebar. Collapsed rail is 64px.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max width of the main content area on very wide monitors.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Default icon size in buttons, nav and tables (Lucide icons, 1.75 stroke).

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky table headers, top bar.

tokens.name: z-dropdown
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, select lists.

tokens.name: z-drawer
tokens.usage: Side drawers (record detail panels).

tokens.name: z-modal
tokens.usage: Modal dialogs and their scrim.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toast notifications.
